- `L 49.15,35.84` — line to (49.15,35.84)  
- `M 49.15,35.84 L 21.22,43.76` — move to (49.15,35.84), line to (21.22,43.76)  

This traces three line segments:  
(21.22,43.76) → (13.59,7.93) → (49.15,35.84) → (21.22,43.76)  

That’s a closed shape with three vertices, so it’s a triangle.
